messages:
maria_gonzalez: Quick question — auditor asked for a smoke-test artifact proving RBAC changes + KMS key rotation didn't drop logging. Need a minimal checklist and the logs sample to hand off.

tom_ng: We have a playbook for rotation but not a compact smoke-test artifact. Can we 1) show a rotate key run, 2) show role/rolebinding update and 3) show logs from ingestion span? Should be <10 files.

auditor_jane: Short is good. They want: evidence of change (git commit + run ID), timeline, logs showing both before/after access attempts, and KMS key metadata showing rotation event. Also chain-of-custody note.

raj_patel: I can assemble: - git commit link for the RBAC patch - k8s rollout job ID - rotation run id from keymgr service - Splunk query excerpt for access logs.

maria_gonzalez: Perfect. For Splunk, what query snippet should we include (make it compact)?

raj_patel: Use this minimal filter (we'll redact PII):
```
index=redwood-logs sourcetype=apiserver (verb=update OR verb=patch) resource=rolebinding OR resource=role user="system:serviceaccount:infra:rotator" | table _time, user, verb, resource, src_ip, request_id
```
Include a line saying we redacted src_ip.

tom_ng: For KMS metadata, include the key version history export. Command we ran: `kmsctl export-history --key-id=projects/redwood/keys/rw-infra-1 --since=2026-03-01 --format=json` — attach the single-file export. Auditor wants an HMAC digest of the file.

auditor_jane: HMAC ok. We also need proof the rotation job succeeded and that no failures were observed in the 24h post-rotation window. A synthetic healthcheck run ID or monitoring alert snapshot is helpful.

maria_gonzalez: I'll capture the rotation job logs from deploy-bot and the post-rotation healthcheck (synth-check id: synth-20260323-11). I'll add a README.md that maps each file to the control requirement (ISO/SOC2 control id references).

deploy-bot: rotation-job rw-rotate-20260323 completed status=success duration=00:02:34 job_id=rotate-20260323-11

raj_patel: For chain-of-custody, include an evidence_manifest.txt with: file list, sha256 checksums, who exported, UTC timestamps, and the HMAC digest. I'll produce it.

maria_gonzalez: One more — do we want to include a short annotated screenshot of the RBAC PR pipeline with the approval trace? auditor_jane: yes, one screenshot is fine.

tom_ng: I'll grab the PR link + approval timestamps and redact comments.

auditor_jane: Great — that'll cover the typical SOC2 evidence ask. Please drop the bundle to the secure share and ping me when ready. :thumbsup:

maria_gonzalez: Will do. ETA for bundle: today EOD. I'll post the share link here once uploaded.

raj_patel: I'll prepare the Splunk query output and checksums now.

maria_gonzalez: Upload link: https://secure-share.redwood.com/s/ea3bT (access: auditor_jane + eng-security). Note: files contain redacted IPs.

auditor_jane: Confirmed I can access and verify HMAC. Quick follow-up: can you include a note about retention policy for these logs? A 90-day retention statement will close one control.

maria_gonzalez: Adding: logs retention = 90 days (index policy), export snapshot included. Closing thread after EOD upload.
